title: Amber Noon Bright

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min midday for a bright, spiced lift.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; avoid spraying near faces or pets.

why_it_works: Citrus bergamot and orange bring a fresh, sunny lift, while a whisper of cinnamon bark adds warm autumn spice that feels cozy and energizing.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
